pages.text: Yara is in the wood. She sees a big red egg in the moss.
pages.picture: a girl finds a big red egg in mossy woods

pages.text: The egg is hot! Yara picks it up and runs back to her den.
pages.picture: girl running home holding a red egg

pages.text: At night, the egg rocks. Then it cracks. Crack! Crack! Crack!
pages.picture: a red egg cracking at night

pages.text: A little dragon pops out. He has red wings and a long tail.
pages.picture: a tiny red baby dragon hatching

pages.text: He huffs. Puff! A big spark pops out.
"You are Fizz," said Yara. "You can be my dragon." Fizz licks her chin.
pages.picture: baby dragon licking the girl's chin
